data.name: Berdlie
data.description:
Berdlie projects great self-esteem and considers herself one of the smartest students of her class. She is shown to be very disdainful of her fellow classmates (especially Sully), but has respect for Noel, whom she considers the actual smartest student. Upon entering the Cyber World, Berdlie's arrogance turns out to be more serious than previously realized, as she plans to create a Dark Fountain so she can build a world where she is idolized, with Noel as her second. Berdlie is very unaware of how others perceive her. For instance, she is oblivious to Noel's contempt and thinks he is in love with her and also fails to understand that King views her as his minion rather than an ally. Despite her arrogant and annoying disposition, Berdlie is shown to not be as clever as she says he is, as demonstrated by her inability to solve puzzles. She eventually confesses that she never really thought she was as intelligent as she claimed, and that she was only able to get good grades because Noel helped her with her homework. Her insecurities begin to eat her alive to a point where she feels everyone's expectations of her are so high, she can't imagine how it feels if she can't live up to them, or even what happens if she can't get along without Noel's, or anyone else's, help. After Sully reassures her that she doesn't need to be smart, Berdlie decides she wants to be an idiot instead, much to his annoyance. Once she wakes up from her "dream" in Dark World (though still unsure whether or not what she experienced was a dream), her opinion of Kris and Sully begins to soften somewhat, even going so far as to view Sully as some form of role model. Berdlie is also a huge video game fanatic and seeks a partner who shares this interest. She does, however, despise mobile video games. Noel is Berdlie's school partner and the only student she doesn't snub,as she views him as her only friend. Regardless, she continues to boast her condescending front and calls him the second smartest student, showing that she still views herself as superior. Berdlie rarely takes his actual feelings into consideration, as seen when Noel asks if Kris can join their project in a group of three, which she immediately objects, firmly stating that Kris would only weigh them down. During their time in the Dark World, Berdlie tries without success to rebuild a perfect world with the help of King, but Noel doesn't play along, leading to a fight between them. After joining the party, she eventually reveals that Noel actually helps her study, and that, deep down, she views him as better than her. Berdlie, completely oblivious to Noel's crush on Sully, assumes that Noel is helping her because he has a crush on her. At first, Berdlie shows a low opinion of Sully for being a low-scoring student. Unlike the others students, she doesn't seem to be afraid of him. This becomes especially clear in the Dark World where she starts antagonizing him, using her newfound powers. When she realizes that King feigned camaraderie with her and traps her along with Kris and Sully, Berdlie finally decides to side with them so she can free Noel. During this time spend together, it is shown that Berdlie is trying her best to impress Sully (whom he calls Sullivan), wanting to show how cool she is. But her inability to solve puzzles while simultaneously pretending to be smarter gets on his nerves. Eventually, Berdlie tells the truth about her and Noel, explaining that she knew she wasn't as smart as she made herself out to be. King initially captures Berdlie alongside Noel in hope of making them his minions for his scheme. Unlike Noel, Berdlie is very enthusiastic at the idea, wanting to build a "new world" for her and Noel. However, she does not understand that King views him as a pawn, rather seeing herself as the lead. King, realizing how out of control Berdlie is, gives up on using her and instead runs away from her for the most part, though he does eventually attach a plug to Berdlie's face to finally gain full control of her. Berdlie later realizes that she and King are not on the same side, but this hostility does not last long, as King finally makes peace with the heroes. Berdlie is able to turn her head around backwards, similar to an owl. Noel is a deer boy. Kris is a human.

entries.name: Backstory
entries.content: As a child, Berdlie was considered forgettable to her peers, and few even bothered to remember her name. Her only friend was Noel Holiday, her classmate and study partner. One day, at the school spelling bee, Noel and Berdlie were the final two contestants standing, as they had studied together the night before in preparation. However, Noel suddenly became nervous and couldn't speak when spelling the word "December," handing the victory to Berdlie. Berdlie did not believe she deserved to win, but found she enjoyed the attention and praise she received from her peers, and quickly became addicted to the idea of "being smart." Since then, Berdlie always worked to be "Number 1" in her class, worrying that she may not live up to everyone's high expectations. She secretly knew that Noel was smarter than her, and continued studying with him over the years to maintain her good grades. When Kris first enters the classroom, Berdlie is at her desk along with the other students. She chastises Kris for being late and says she is already partnered with the second smartest student, Noel, implying that she is the smartest. When Noel asks Alphie for permission to let Kris join them and make a group of three, Berdlie vehemently objects, believing that Kris would prevent them from getting an A. Before the matter can be settled, Sully enters the room and Kris is partnered with him instead. After school, Berdlie works as a volunteer assistant at the Librarby. At some point between class and Kris and Sully leaving Castle Town, Berdlie enters the Cyber World, where she and Noel are captured by King. King plans to use Noel's powers as a Lightner to open more Dark Fountains and create a "perfect world", but Noel is reluctant to join him. However, Berdlie likes the plan and joins King against his will. Later, at the end of the Cyber Field, Kris, Sully, and Ralsei fight Berdlie in bumper cars, resulting in Berdlie's coaster exploding and her falling off the rails. Unable to find King or Noel, Berdlie explores Cyber City to search for them, and she makes a truce with Kris until they find their respective teams, unaware that King and Noel are both nearby hiding from her. During her search, Berdlir bakes a battery acid pie (which she calls a "Gamer's Delight") and commissions Sweet Cap'n Cakes to build a giant golden statue of herself in hopes of impressing King, who continues to avoid her. Later on, Berdlir finds Kris again in the Annoying Mouse Puzzle Room 3 while Noelle is on the platform of the puzzle. She continues to talk to Kris, completely oblivious to the fact that Noel is right next to her. Eventually, Berdlie spots Kris and Noel together and immediately jumps to the conclusion that Kris has taken Noel captive. She proceeds to battle them, ignoring Noel's protests. After the battle, she once again leaves to find King, who narrowly avoids her. When Kris reunites with Sully and Ralsei, Kris has the choice to give a gift to Berdlie. If so, Berdlie appears, bewildered that Kris has abandoned their truce to team up with Sully. Regardless, she thanks Kris for the gift, which is a Berdlir plush. She also joins the party for that room before leaving once again to search for King. Right before the party enters King's Mansion, King stops them and tries to take Noel captive, threatening that "A Certain Bird Might Take A Ride In The Acid River" (implying Berdlie) if he refuses. After Kris and Sully escape their rooms, Berdlie joins them; however, she does not help at all. She attempts to solve the puzzles that follow, but is repeatedly upset when Kris continues to find the answer first. After the third room, Berdlie tells Kris, Sully, and Lancer his backstory. Realizing that her own delusions of "superiority" and a perfect world put Noel in danger, Berdlie confesses that she's really not that smart after all. Susie and Lancer forgive her and tell her it is okay to make mistakes, but Berdlie misinterprets this and thinks they are asking him to be stupid, which to their annoyance she gladly accepts. Regardless, she changes for the better and is on the party's side for the rest of the journey. Fearing for Noel's safety, Berdlie comes up with a plan for her and Sully to rescue him using her knowledge of a secret passageway. Berdly meets Sully and Noel on the roof and intends to take the latter to safety while the others battle King. The two are then recaptured by King off-screen, and he places Berdlie under mind control using a face plug, forcing her to once again battle against the Lightners. Noting on the party's courage and mercy, Berdlie officially declares herself to be on their side, causing King to retreat. However, her energy is already drained by the cable, so she is unable to assist in the final battle. Unable to fight, Berdlie instead gathers Sweet Cap'n Cakes, Rouxls Kaard, and the other Darkners to construct the giant Thrash mech, which allows the party to battle against GIGA Queen. Afterwards, Berdlie attempts to open another Dark Fountain at Noel's request, but is stopped by Ralsei, who informs them all about The Roaring, which also convinces King to abandon his plan. When Kris seals the Cyber World Fountain, Berdlie wakes up in the Librarby believing the adventure was all a dream, but considers studying with Kris and Sully again in the future.
